_comment: Curated physical header layouts for the pin picker, one per board that has a published, verified header order. This is DATA, not derived: the GPIO numbers come from the netlist / pins_arduino.h, but which row and which silk label a pad sits on is read off the real board. gen_board_descriptor.py merges these into the descriptors as the `phys` key. Boards with no entry fall back to the generic two-column diagram.
